_readme: Vapi function tools for Ava. Replace N8N_BASE with your n8n URL. Each tool posts a 'tool-calls' message to its server URL; the n8n workflow must reply with {"results":[{"toolCallId":"...","result":"..."}]} via a Respond to Webhook node. Docs: https://docs.vapi.ai/server-url/events , https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/custom-tools

function.name: lookup_customer
function.description: Look up an existing customer or lead by phone number to greet them by name and see open appointments or jobs.

function.name: save_qualification
function.description: Save the caller's qualification answers. Call once all answers are collected, or immediately if the caller opts out.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Get up to two open 1-hour inspection slots on or after the preferred date (business hours Mon–Sat, America/Chicago).

function.name: book_inspection
function.description: Book the free inspection after the caller confirmed date, time and address.

destinations.description: On-call manager for structural or water emergencies
Office, when the caller asks for a human during business hours
